title: We pay 29% of what we bid
meaning: Second-price auctions hide a large overbid. Under first-price auctions the same bids would cost 3.4× as much, so bid shading toward the market price is the main saving.

title: Floor prices set the price on high-floor inventory
number: floor set the price on 21.2% of all wins, and 53% of wins with floors above 100; win rate 37.1% there vs 63.4% with no floor
meaning: High-floor inventory is priced by the publisher, not by competition. Check that its CTR justifies the price (Notebook 05, floor band) before bidding into it.
